sources.observation: The east portal sits below repeated arched panels, deep horizontal cornices and the taper of the central tower. Subsidiary towers are visibly lower and have their own narrow crowns.

limitations: The main tower uses the 50-metre height reported by UNESCO. Subsidiary tower heights, individual niches, figures and upper profiles are exterior approximations based on the photo and native footprint.
The placement covers the principal temple, its attached entry pavilion and the stone podium. The Bodhi Tree, pink arcade and detached stupas and shrines stay in the wider site.
Terrarium grades supply the placement datum. Submetre exterior heights and materials have been approximated.
